basis: IMNCI sample: more than one convulsion in this illness = general danger sign; fever + danger sign => VERY SEVERE FEBRILE DISEASE, refer URGENTLY (pink)

basis: IMNCI sample: none of the some/severe dehydration criteria met; 'no dehydration' (green) is not written in the sample text and is inferred from the absence of the listed criteria
